name: Boogleswarm

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

languages: Understands Common but can only speak if the swarm has gathered at least one Humanoid tooth

traits.name: Mimicry (Only if the Swarm Can Speak)
traits.summary: Speaks in the voice of anyone whose tooth it implanted; a DC 13 Wis (Insight) check spots the fake.
traits.text: Once it can speak, the swarm can imitate the voice of any creature whose tooth it has implanted. A listener who succeeds on a DC 13 Wisdom (Insight) check realises it is an imitation.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.summary: Shares spaces with other creatures, fits through any gap a weasel fits; can't heal or gain Temporary Hit Points.
traits.text: The swarm can move into and stay in another creature's space, and other creatures can enter its space. It can pass through any opening wide enough for one Tiny weasel. The swarm can't regain Hit Points and can't gain Temporary Hit Points.

traits.name: Sweet Tooth
traits.summary: Seeing or smelling sugar at its turn's start, it must spend all its movement heading for it; on arrival it is Incapacitated until its next turn, and the trait is spent until a rest.
traits.text: If the swarm can see or smell sugar at the start of its turn, it must use all of its movement to go closer to it. If it reaches the sugar it eats it and is Incapacitated until the start of its next turn; the trait then doesn't work again until the swarm finishes a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Bites, each at a different target.

actions.name: Bite

damage.when: instead, while the swarm is Bloodied

actions.summary: +4, 4d4 Piercing (2d4 once Bloodied); a target with teeth makes a DC 12 Con save or loses one, which the swarm implants in itself.
actions.text: A creature with teeth that is hit makes a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or loses a tooth, and the swarm at once implants it in one of its mouths. A creature that has already lost a tooth to this attack automatically succeeds on the save.

summary: A mob of tooth-collecting fey weasels that bites in two directions at once and steals teeth, and will drop everything for a sweet.
